summary: Old Second Bancorp Inc filed an 8-K disclosing a new $61.2 million share repurchase program authorized by its Board, effective July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027. The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago has issued a nonobjection. Repurchases may be conducted via open market, trading plans, or private transactions at management's discretion based on market conditions and regulatory requirements. The program is discretionary, with no obligation to repurchase any shares; it replaces an existing plan expiring June 30, 2026. Watch for execution pace and any regulatory constraints.
